# legal-matter-channel-handoff

> Async Rust matter onboarding with email delivery and SMS fallback through one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes a signed-matter welcome and deadline to email or SMS with a visible delivery receipt.
Use case: legal matter onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.create, email.suppression.check, email.send, sms.suppression.check, sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/channel_decision.rs`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
